name: LEGO Islands Minigame
author: atrik1978
description:
This is my first game, guided by the LEGO tutorials.
Explore the islands and discover secret pickups and enemies on your adventure!
It may take a few attempts to fully identify the elements that help you win 😉

Just a warning: beware of the Killer Mini Hippo 😂

First published on 02 April 2021.
It was completely guided by the LEGO tutorials with little customisation.

Modified on 05 April 2021
1. Changed the firing from Cannonball to Arrows.
2. Added new structures in the mini island

Modified on 13 April 2021
1. Added a killer Mini Hippo in one of the islands.
2. Added messenger figures and kill switches.

Modified on 23 April 2021
Customised the menus.

Modified on 30 April 2021
1. Removed a bug from Menu Lose button
2. Added newer islands, challenges and pickups.

Looking forward to your opinions and suggestions.
